The Battle Cats meet Ranma 1/2 in collaboration event


The Battle Cats meets the Ranma 1/2 cast in the game’s latest collaboration event! From 17 May to 31 May 10:59, players can obtain the various Ranma 1/2 cast through the Battle Cats capsules, featuring five mighty new Uber Rare heroes, including Ranma Saotome, Akane Tendo, and other fan-favorite characters with wild magical transformations based on the plot of the Ranma 1/2 manga! The set also includes limited edition Super Rare & Rare heroes featuring chibi and cat-ified characters from the comics, each a powerful addition to any player’s Cat Army!   Related Posts   Pokemon Sleep Now Available In Malaysia   GamerBraves Newsletter Vol. 103 – The Glory of The Barbie/Oppenheimer Double Feature   You can also face down the challengers in the event maps, where you can get Ranma Cat from the Rumble at the Tendo Dojo, or make the pilgrimage to The Cursed Springs for a tag-team showdown for huge XP rewards awaiting winners. If even that wasn’t enough for you, square up to the ultimate gauntlet challenge, the Test of Might, Ranma 1/2 edition! The cast will stand in your way as mighty foes, each new level offering bigger rewards and meaner enemies than the last!
Don’t miss out on getting the wacky and wonderful cast in a game filled with other weird cats. Wonder if the curses can work on the cats; that would be one heck of another crossover surely.

reference_summary: The Battle Cats, permainan mudah alih yang popular, bekerjasama dengan Ranma 1/2 dalam acara masa terhad dari 17 hingga 31 Mei. Pemain boleh mendapatkan lima wira Uber Rare, termasuk Ranma Saotome dan Akane Tendo, serta Super edisi terhad Wira Rare & Rare. Peta acara termasuk Rumble at the Tendo Dojo dan The Cursed Springs, di mana pemain boleh memperoleh ganjaran XP. Cabaran utama, Test of Might, edisi Ranma 1/2, menampilkan pelakon sebagai musuh yang hebat. Jangan ketinggalan untuk menambah watak aneh dan hebat ini pada Tentera Kucing anda!
